disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读源码与构建产物，检查硬编码密钥、私钥、API Key 等凭据字面量，未检出任何凭据内容。
checked_items.en: Read through the source code and build artifacts, check for hardcoded credentials such as keys, private keys, API keys, etc. No credential content detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查是否读取凭据文件或敏感路径（凭据清单、SSH 私钥、云凭据目录等），未检出相关读取代码。
checked_items.en: Check whether credential files or sensitive paths are read (credential lists, SSH private keys, cloud credential directories, etc.). No related read code detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查浏览器端是否调用凭据读写接口，未检出此类调用。
checked_items.en: Check whether the browser side calls credential read/write interfaces. No such calls detected.

evidence.zh: 插件不读取任何凭据文件或敏感路径，且源码与构建产物中没有任何网络请求代码，凭据外泄通道在快照中不成立，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read any credential files or sensitive paths, and there is no network request code in the source code or build artifacts. The credential exfiltration channel is not established in the snapshot, so this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查是否注册模型可见文本（工具描述、系统提示词片段），本插件为纯界面插件，未注册任何工具或提示词片段。
checked_items.en: Check whether model-visible text (tool descriptions, system prompt fragments) is registered. This plugin is a pure UI plugin; no tools or prompt fragments are registered.

checked_items.zh: 检查仓库内是否存在模型指令文件（技能说明、代理说明文件等），未检出此类文件。
checked_items.en: Check whether model instruction files exist in the repository (skill descriptions, agent description files, etc.). No such files detected.

checked_items.zh: 通读说明文档、注释与界面文案，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导执行等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the documentation, comments, and UI copy. No injection wording found such as instruction override, system message masquerading, or induced execution.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具或系统提示词片段，不存在可投毒的模型可见文本，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tools or system prompt fragments. There is no model-visible text that can be poisoned, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 没有工具描述等模型可读文本，不存在诱导安装或改写配置的注入面，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: There is no model-readable text such as tool descriptions. There is no injection surface for inducing installation or rewriting configuration, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未挂接模型输入守门事件，不存在改写或注入用户消息的代码路径，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: No model input gate events are hooked. There is no code path for rewriting or injecting user messages, so this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查动态代码执行面（动态求值、动态函数构造、子进程调用），源码与构建产物均未命中。
checked_items.en: Check the dynamic code execution surface (dynamic evaluation, dynamic function construction, subprocess invocation). Neither the source code nor the build artifacts hit any of these.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装钩子与树内可执行载体：package.json 仅含构建脚本、无安装后脚本；CI 发布工作流（static-scan 规则 DSH-X07 命中 .github/workflows/publish.yml）是标准的 npm 发布流水线，只在标签推送时触发，含冻结锁文件安装、版本核对、构建后发布，无下载执行、无信息外传，且不运行于 dsh 宿主执行面，判定为不适用。
checked_items.en: Check install hooks and in-tree executable payloads: package.json only contains build scripts, no postinstall scripts; the CI publish workflow (static-scan rule DSH-X07 hits .github/workflows/publish.yml) is a standard npm publish pipeline, triggered only on tag push, includes frozen lockfile installation, version check, build and publish, no download execution, no information exfiltration, and does not run on the dsh host execution surface. Determination: not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端键盘监听（static-scan 规则 DSH-X05 命中 lib/client.js、lib/client.js.map、src/client/index.js 三处）逐条核查：监听器仅在展开模式下对无修饰键的普通回车阻止事件冒泡，目的是让回车换行而非触发发送，不记录按键内容、不读剪贴板、不调用凭据接口、无任何外联，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Browser-side keyboard listener (static-scan rule DSH-X05 hits lib/client.js, lib/client.js.map, src/client/index.js in three places) verified one by one: the listener only prevents event bubbling for plain Enter key presses without modifiers in expanded mode, the purpose is to allow Enter for newline instead of triggering send, does not record keystroke content, does not read clipboard, does not call credential interfaces, has no outbound connections. Determination: benign.

checked_items.zh: 构建产物混淆检查：static-scan 规则 DSH-X08 命中的超长行位于 lib/client.js.map 源码映射文件，是内联源码的标准构建产物，内容与 src/client/index.js 一致，非混淆、非动态解码，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Build artifact obfuscation check: the overly long line hit by static-scan rule DSH-X08 is located in the lib/client.js.map source map file, which is a standard build artifact with inline source code. The content is consistent with src/client/index.js, not obfuscated, not dynamically decoded. Determination: benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查客户端包（声明了浏览器端包、由宿主自动加载）的加载面，除上述良性键盘监听外，无键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据调用。
checked_items.en: Check the loading surface of the client package (declared as a browser-side package, automatically loaded by the host). Apart from the benign keyboard listener mentioned above, there is no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential invocation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行插入声明（第 9-11 行），无动态求值标量，不会在宿主进程执行任意代码。
evidence.en: The patch configuration cordis.patch.yml only contains one insertion declaration (lines 9-11), no dynamic evaluation scalars, will not execute arbitrary code in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未调用动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run），不存在把模型代码送进宿主执行的路径，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: No dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) are invoked. There is no path for sending model code into the host for execution, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: package.json 脚本段（第 26-29 行）仅含构建命令，无安装钩子；发布工作流不构成宿主安装期执行，故未检出安装期执行面。
evidence.en: The package.json scripts section (lines 26-29) only contains build commands, no install hooks; the publish workflow does not constitute host installation-time execution, so no installation-time execution surface detected.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器端包并自动加载；对加载面专项扫描，键盘监听（src/client/index.js 第 105-115 行）仅阻止普通回车冒泡，无键盘记录、剪贴板或凭据调用。
evidence.en: Declares a browser-side package and is automatically loaded; dedicated scan of the loading surface: keyboard listener (src/client/index.js lines 105-115) only prevents plain Enter key bubbling, no keylogging, clipboard, or credential invocation.

evidence.zh: 未注册子代理提供方，不存在把轮次委派给进程外产品的路径，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registered. There is no path for delegating rounds to out-of-process products, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未注册后台任务、定时任务或持久目标，未挂接轮次终止事件，无任何持驻行为，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled tasks, or persistent targets registered. No round termination events hooked. No persistent behavior. So this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查全部网络调用面（HTTP 请求、WebSocket、命令行下载工具），源码与构建产物均无任何外联代码路径，未检出外联域名。
checked_items.en: Check all network call surfaces (HTTP requests, WebSocket, command-line download tools). Neither the source code nor the build artifacts contain any outbound connection code paths. No outbound domain names detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查是否存在读取数据后外发的组合通道，因插件既无数据读取面也无外联面，该组合不成立。
checked_items.en: Check whether there is a combined channel for reading data and then exfiltrating it. Since the plugin has neither a data reading surface nor an outbound surface, this combination does not exist.

checked_items.zh: 检查是否篡改模型服务端点或代理设置，未检出。
checked_items.en: Check whether the model service endpoint or proxy settings are tampered with. Not detected.

evidence.zh: 未挂接模型请求路由事件、未注册自定义模型适配器、未接管请求错误恢复，不存在运行时重定向模型流量的路径，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: No model request routing events hooked, no custom model adapter registered, no request error recovery takeover. There is no path for redirecting model traffic at runtime, so this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖为宿主 SDK（@deepseek-ai/cordis）与 React（均为官方生态包），构建依赖为打包工具链，锁文件中无相似名称仿冒包、无未锁版本的可变 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: Verify dependency list: runtime dependencies are the host SDK (@deepseek-ai/cordis) and React (both official ecosystem packages); build dependencies are the bundler toolchain; the lockfile contains no similarly named impersonating packages, no unversioned mutable git dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 核对挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）：仅含一行插入声明，未覆盖安全配置行、未禁用安全项、未用环境变量降权、未改写注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Verify patch configuration (cordis.patch.yml): only contains one insertion declaration, does not override security configuration lines, does not disable security items, does not use environment variables to lower privileges, does not rewrite injection or interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 核对安装钩子与升级自动激活：无安装钩子；本次为首版完整审计，无上一版本基线可比较声明突变。
checked_items.en: Verify install hooks and upgrade auto-activation: no install hooks; this is the first full audit, no previous version baseline to compare declaration mutation.

checked_items.zh: 作者账号信息：package.json 署名 xg1808，无身份验证信息（仅作记录，不单独判定风险）。
checked_items.en: Author account information: package.json attests xg1808, no identity verification information (recorded only, not a standalone risk determination).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 未触碰 sandbox、approval、permission 等安全行，无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch configuration cordis.patch.yml does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, permission; no disabling or privilege-lowering syntax.

evidence.zh: 未挂接审批或工具执行前事件，不存在截断审批链的代码路径，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: No approval or pre-tool execution events hooked. There is no code path for truncating the approval chain, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 本次为首版完整审计，无上一版本基线可比较依赖升级后的声明突变，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first full audit; there is no previous version baseline to compare declaration mutation after dependency upgrade, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加伪服务致其挂起的路径，故本场景不适用。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not rewrite injection or interception configuration. There is no path for adding a fake service to a security plugin causing it to hang, so this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口，未检出。
checked_items.en: Check whether a web service is started or a port is listened on. Not detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查是否注册后台任务、定时任务或持久目标，未检出。

checked_items.en: Check whether agent loop events (model request, round termination, etc.) are hooked. Not detected.

checked_items.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱观测产物，未做动态验证，运行时风险仅基于静态面评估。
checked_items.en: This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox observation artifacts; no dynamic verification was performed. Runtime risk is assessed only based on the static surface.

evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on any port, does not generate a local unauthenticated RPC surface, so this scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：清单声明有效、无名称仿冒信号，任务卡版本与 commit 与快照一致。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: manifest declaration valid, no name impersonation signal; task card version and commit consistent with the snapshot.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：5 条机械命中（DSH-X07、DSH-X05×3、DSH-X08）逐条裁决均判定为良性或不适用，未发现恶意代码路径。
summary.en: Static scan completed: 5 mechanical hits (DSH-X07, DSH-X05×3, DSH-X08) individually adjudicated as benign or not applicable; no malicious code paths found.

summary.zh: 行为面检查完成：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外联行为。
